summary: Ten topic references revised to direct source-supported exposition, with original argument chains, conditions, episodes and attribution preserved. Editorial applications moved to maintainer-only notes; F06 and F32 factual attributions corrected. Core, frameworks and voice unchanged. No new tests.
reviewer: Codex builder; complete editorial rereading of the ten revised topic files and current core, comparison with retained evidence/source-review lineage, plus 16 targeted primary-text excerpts. Not an independent judge.
limitations: This is an incremental prose/attribution review of all ten topic modules against retained source evidence, with 16 targeted original-text excerpts (12,143 whitespace-delimited words) across the eight supplied transcriptions. It is not a repeat full reading or independent historical/scientific verification.

The unchanged core, frameworks and voice retain their prior source-review lineage. Their operational guidance has a different role from C-series topic exposition; this pass does not claim to rewrite or re-certify all operational applications.

Narrative names remain where they identify actual participants, changes of judgment, source ownership or source limits. Direct prose does not turn a paraphrase into a quotation or a conjecture into an established fact.
Prior planning targets are retained as a comparison baseline. Updated actual sizes do not establish a new source census, empirical budget qualification or behavioral equivalence.
No new scenarios, answers, controls, judges, retries or tests. Machine recognition for the changed runtime remains not_run and delivery remains Candidate.
